metas.name: Inside Job
metas.description: The essential one. Oscar-winning, tightly argued, with tough interviews of economists and officials. Goldman features heavily.

metas.name: Panic: The Untold Story of the 2008 Financial Crisis
metas.description: The rescue told by the people who ran it: Bernanke, Paulson, Geithner. Best inside view of the bailout decisions.

metas.name: Abacus: Small Enough to Jail
metas.description: Steve James on the only US bank criminally charged after the crisis: a small family bank in Chinatown. Unrelated to Goldman's Abacus deal.

metas.name: HyperNormalisation
metas.description: Adam Curtis. Traces how finance took power from politicians, starting with New York's 1975 fiscal crisis.

metas.name: Capital in the Twenty-First Century
metas.description: Based on Piketty's book. Archival-collage style close to Adam Curtis.
